Hey, you, puppy!
Yeah, I'm talking to you.

Hate to break it to ya, but I've already chosen my trainer.
—Hey, you.

...Hmph.
If you've got no complaints... keep your mouth shut and watch, "Trainer"?

Startled, I managed to flee the alley—
yet her parting word, "choose," kept echoing persistently in my mind...

...I couldn't turn them down again. It was a rare opportunity, and I wanted to
watch the race properly... but it's my own fault for not being assertive.

Me too...!! Won't you please aim for the Triple Crown with me?!
I may be a rookie, but I promise to prepare the perfect environment, data, and strategy!

What are you doing over there?!
Come give us a hand here, too!

Ooh...! She's finally stepped onto the track...!
None other than the Symboli family's prized horse girl—Sirius Symboli!
Got no objections, right?

I broke your leash. Bare your fangs, or tuck your tail and run—
the rest is for you to "choose."

—Starting today, you're my Trainer.
Got any objections?

—That covers our future roadmap.
We'll stick to this plan right up until your debut.

What a magnificent run...!! With your talent, you could conquer
the Classic Triple Crown!! I vow to pour all my experience into training you!

Overwhelmed by the fiery zeal of the other trainers, I couldn't get a word in.
Even so, I lingered about, waiting for my chance, but...

Sirius Symboli... A haughty, supreme horse girl overflowing with confidence.
Under the fierce weight of her gaze, I found myself completely speechless—

Yeah, she's put up incredible results in all her mock races so far.
I can't wait to see what kind of performance she delivers today.

The training regimen she proposed was flawless and airtight...
Above all, her tone carried an imposing pressure that brooked no argument.

Kicking up the turf with extraordinary power,
she tore through the track at will, utterly dominating her rivals.
Huh?

I recalled her commanding run. Being able to train such an incredible
horse girl is nothing short of the ultimate privilege for any trainer.

—The scent of the night air, the glow of neon signs, the chaotic city noise.
I had completely forgotten that the dark streets conceal plenty of thrills and danger...

My racing heart wouldn't calm down. I wanted to see more of her running...
Driven by that urge, I started moving toward her—only to be stopped.
You too.
Don't worry, it'll only take a second! Come on, over this way!

Before I knew it, a horse girl was standing right beside me.
Apparently, she was the one who had kicked the wall to intimidate the guy...

It's always like this... I hate how timid I am.
At times like this, giving up and riding it out is all I can—

—...
One fox and one puppy, huh?
GRAAAAUUUUUUGGGHHHHHH!!!!
Determined to scout a trainee of my own, I eagerly headed over to observe the races—

It didn't slow her down in the least...!
Just as the rumors said, what monstrous power!!

Even a puppy's got fangs, don't they?
Don't let 'em just sit there for show.
Eep...?! W-What was that sound...?!
With every clod of heavy turf she kicked up, her fighting spirit surged even higher—

Come on now, don't say that! Just hear me out~~!
I've got a seriously juuuiii-cy deal for you... You're interested, right?
(SLAM...!)

You really get a kick out of preying on scared little critters?
...What a pathetic beast.

I recalled her supremely confident expression when she rescued me in the alley.
Yes, with those very same eyes—

...!
The track should still be yielding from the early morning rain, and yet—

Why did she choose me, someone who couldn't even speak up to her...?
I didn't know. Even so—

All racers are locked into the gates!
Today's Selection Race—is underway!

A ferocious intensity that commanded the crowd, screaming "this is my moment!"...
I had never seen a run like that before.

Hey, over here! Put one there, and another in that corner!
Man, you're a lifesaver. Thanks for helping with the setup!
...Hmph—!! Haaah—!!
Unleashing a roar like a ravenous wolf, she claimed victory.

However—that enthusiasm evaporated immediately.
The following day, I eagerly brought the training menu I had drawn up, but—

A few days later, the "Selection Races" were held, giving pre-debut
horse girls a stage to showcase their skills and earn scouts from trainers.
